name: The Platta Law Firm
about: The Platta Law Firm is a personal injury firm with a single office in Manhattan.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

subs.label: Experience

subs.label: Accountability

subs.label: Search authority

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 1 operational Google Business Profile listing with reviews · profile completeness, NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank not yet measured (4 of 5 pts still available)

subs.label: Free consult & fee transparency
subs.evidence: Free consultation · Contingency · the fee percentage itself is not published
